answer: A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The wharf counter is kept in pigment and crystal shows each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 39 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
